name: Vermund
summary: Human kingdom ruled by a line of Sovran who earned the throne by defeating the Dragon. Starting kingdom, west/central map.

name: Battahl
summary: Kingdom of the Beastren, a different culture and nation, reached by crossing the border. Arid south-east.

name: Unmoored World
summary: Secret endgame region reached through a choice in Legacy. Own NPCs, trials and post-game quests.

name: Norgan
summary: Snowy Far North region, separate map, own Portcrystals.

name: Borderwatch Outpost
summary: Where you land after escaping the excavation site. Has a Riftstone, shops, inn, lounge. First side quests (Provisioner's Plight, Ordeals of a New Recruit). Exit leads to northern Vermund and Mt. Alles base.

name: Melve
summary: Small burnt-out town southwest of the Outpost. Inn, apothecary, houses, helpers needed. Crafting materials on the edges.

name: Vernworth
summary: The capital. Common, Merchant, Noble, Mercantile and Residential districts, Slums, Castle (gaol tower, vault, audience chamber), Gracious Hand, Pawn and Vocation Guilds. Hub for most main quests and ~25 side quests.

name: Harve Village
summary: Coastal village south of Trevo Mine, southwest of Vernworth. Northern Harve Ruins nearby hold bandits and a cell with loot.

name: Sacred Arbor
summary: Woodland settlement north of Vernworth around the Arborheart tree (Riftstone). Woodcutters and craftsmen (Grisha, Glyndwr). Grisha's Armory.

name: Moonglow Garden
summary: Beren's recruit-training area (Claw Them Into Shape).

name: Nameless Village
summary: North of the Eastern Forest. A thief-run village (Srail) with an underground obstacle course and Depths. Missable story quest.

name: Checkpoint Rest Town
summary: Border settlement between Vermund and Battahl. Celeste's Smithy, Ibrahim's Scrap Store, Myrddin's Home, Pawn/Vocation facilities. Many shops.

name: Ancient Battleground
summary: Found by following the road out of Checkpoint Rest Town. Ruined castle site with a Cyclops chest, locked rooms (Oskar's key quest).

name: Mountain Shrine
summary: Cave reachable only after speaking with the Sphinx. Riddle site.

name: Moonglint Tower
summary: Special location open only during and after the endgame.

name: Bakbattahl
summary: Capital of Battahl. Flamebearer Palace, Gaol, Pawn/Vocation guilds, Oxcart Station, Wanderer's Haven, Isaac's Wares, Brokkr's Smithy, Awaran's Arms. Ropeway network.

name: Agamen Volcanic Island
summary: Volcanic region with Volcanic Island Camp (Armory, Riftstone, Geyser Hamlet hot spring), Drabnir's Grotto. Hosts Magick Archer and Warfarer vocation quests.

name: Seafloor Shrine
summary: Submerged, opened after Convergence. Armories (Vermundian, Battahli, Dwarven, Elven), guild branches.

name: Excavation Site
summary: Northern digsite with Overseers' Lodge, Agamen Ruins and apothecary (Zachary).

name: Flamebearer Palace
summary: Beastren seat of power. Audience chamber, prayer hall, Empress's chambers.

name: Battahl wilds
summary: Wild areas of Battahl: Wyrmsblood Forest, Indigent Bedlands, Misty Marshes, Malachite Forest, Windworn Gully.

name: Norgandian Settlement
summary: Your base in Norgan. Has a Portcrystal, the relic appraiser and, after Hammer and Tongs, Hal's workshop.

name: Norgan travel
summary: Only Norgan Portcrystals work in Norgan. Fixed ones: Norgandian Settlement, Rivercave Campground (north of the settlement) and Shrine of Wisdom (far north-west). You also get a free portable one after Chilling Tidings that can only be placed in Norgan.
